   - Calculation: 1,194 / 1,441 = 82.86%

   - Calculation: 8,359 / 10,631 = 78.63%
   - Cross-check (declared basis): $1.94 annualized dividend per share / $2.46 diluted EPS = 78.86%
   - Source: KO FY2024 10-K (ko-20241231.htm)

3. PepsiCo (PEP): 75.48%
